summary: Manual distillation and embeddings are allowed for explanation, retrieval, and operator guidance only. They are not an execution source for Tcl, K-language, or HyperMesh commands.

Resolve LS-DYNA keyword operations through structured maps first: keyword_index.json, hm_dictionary.json, verified mappings, then optional manual notes for explanation. Manual notes remain advisory and never authorize Tcl/K execution.

A manual paragraph or embedding hit can be semantically relevant but still unsuitable for direct execution. Commands must be verified in templates/hm_command_map.json or the dedicated keyword dictionaries before use.
Plastic-kinematic material planning note. Use this only to explain expected material fields and unit-consistency checks; HyperMesh cardimage and datanames still come from structured verified maps.

Solid section planning note. Use this only to explain section intent and likely field review order; HyperMesh property cardimage and datanames still require recording or trusted dictionary verification.
Termination-control planning note. Use this only to explain termination fields such as ENDTIM and related stop conditions; it must not provide executable values or datanames.

Timestep-control planning note. Use this only to explain stability, mass-scaling, timestep-limit, and erosion-control review items; HyperMesh card edits require recorded datanames in the target profile.
Initial detonation planning note. Use this only to explain that initiation setup is model-specific and unit-sensitive; do not infer source, timing, or set fields from manual text or embeddings.
Blast-load planning note. Use this only to explain blast-load review concerns such as source definition, units, and target sets; execution requires structured verified HyperMesh datanames.

Binary d3plot output planning note. Use this only to explain output cadence and time-window review; HyperMesh card edits require recorded datanames and must not be inferred from embeddings or manual text.
